findings.evidence: grep `filtrationPrevious` over ./code returns only Filtration.lean:187 and :193 — the definition `CliffordAlgebra.filtrationPrevious` is removed by the diff; grep `mul_mem_filtrationPrevious` over the whole tree returns only those two declaration sites, no uses. Naming conventions: "This is to ensure that `_`-separated strings in a lemma name correspond to a definition name or connective."
findings.fix: Delete both; the two call sites they served are gone and the canonical names are `TauCeti.Algebra.mul_mem_wordFiltrationPrevious_left/_right` applied at `ι Q` (which now unify with `filtration Q` since it is an `abbrev`).
findings.issue: `mul_mem_filtrationPrevious_left` (:187) and `mul_mem_filtrationPrevious_right` (:193) name `CliffordAlgebra.filtrationPrevious`, which this PR deletes; their statements now spell `wordFiltrationPrevious (ι Q)`, so the `_`-separated components no longer correspond to any declaration. findings.evidence: AssociatedGraded.lean:107 `abbrev GradedPiece (f : M →ₗ[R] A) (k : ℕ) : Type w` vs :111 `abbrev associatedGraded (f : M →ₗ[R] A) : Type w`. Naming conventions rule 2 (`Type`s are `UpperCamelCase`) with rule 3 (functions are named as their return values).
findings.fix: Rename to `AssociatedGraded` (and update the ~10 uses in `TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/CliffordAlgebra/PBW.lean`, e.g. `associatedGraded (ι Q)` at :261, :288, :300).
findings.issue: `abbrev associatedGraded (f) : Type w` is a type-valued declaration named in lowerCamelCase, while `abbrev GradedPiece` three lines above (:107) — same kind of declaration in the same file — is UpperCamelCase. Users cannot guess which convention a given piece of this new API follows.

summary: The prior naming findings are fixed, but two leftover Clifford lemmas keep `filtrationPrevious` in their names after this PR deletes that declaration, and the new type abbrev `associatedGraded` is lowerCamelCase while the `GradedPiece` beside it is UpperCamelCase.
